title: Sumisip LGU condemns attacks on Army troops in Basilan

blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – The local government unit (LGU) of Sumisip in Basilan province has condemned the series of deadly armed attacks targeting troops of the Philippine Army’s 45th Infantry Battalion (45th IB). In a statement on Monday evening, the Sumisip LGU denounced the two recent ambush incidents, emphasizing that such acts threaten the peace and security of communities across the province. The attacks occurred in two separate incidents earlier this month: first on October 5 while 45IB troops were passing through Barangay Badja in Tipo-Tipo town, and on October 8 in Barangay Sabong, Lamitan City.
